blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Automated generation of production-ready 3D garment assets from a single image is a central challenge in digital content creation. While recent generative models have significantly advanced 3D geometry reconstruction, synthesizing high-quality textures remains a bottleneck. Existing methods often bake environmental illumination and shadows directly into the texture map, or they fail to maintain global structural coherence, making the resulting assets unusable for physical simulation and relighting. In this work, we introduce OmniFabric, a novel approach that synthesizes globally coherent texture maps directly within the 2D sewing pattern space. Given a single reference image, our pipeline utilizes an estimated 3D mesh and generative priors of powerful Vision-Language Models (VLM) to establish a complete but coarse texture initialization across the unwrapped sewing patterns. We then leverage a specialized diffusion transformer, trained via an automated synthetic data engine and conditioned on 3D positional features, to refine this initialization directly in the canonical UV domain. This effectively removes distortion and baked-in artifacts to extract a clean and normalized texture map that preserves the original garment design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniFabric significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding photorealistic 3D garments with high-quality textures. Project page: https://humansensinglab.github.io/OmniFabric

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Creating high-fidelity, simulation-ready 3D garments is essential for modern digital production, with applications spanning gaming ( Habermann et al., 2021 ) , e-commerce ( Hwangbo et al., 2020 ; Kim and LaBat, 2013 ) , and cinematic visual effects ( Hughes et al., 2007 ) . While traditional asset creation relies on labor-intensive manual modeling, there is growing interest in automating this process to synthesize assets directly from images. Despite recent strides in reconstructing accurate 3D garment geometry ( Bian et al., 2025 ; Nakayama et al., 2025 ; Sarafianos et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Rong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , generating production-ready textures from a single observation remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 制作高纯度、模拟准备的3D服装对现代数字生产至关重要,其应用跨越游戏(Habermann等人,2021年),电子商务 (Hwangbo等人,2020年;Kim和LaBat,2013年),以及电影视觉效果(Hughes等人,2007年). 虽然传统的资产创造依赖于劳动密集型人工模型,但人们越来越有兴趣使这一过程自动化,直接从图像中合成资产。 尽管近期在重建准确的3D服装几何学方面有所进展(Bian等人,2025年;中山等人,2025年;Sarafianos等人,2025年;He等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年b;Rong等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年),从单一观测中产生生产准备的纹理仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Garment texture synthesis is uniquely difficult due to the complex dynamics of fabric, which frequently produce deep folds, self-occlusions, and extreme pose variations (see Figure 1 ). To be truly usable in downstream applications, a texture must not only look realistic in a static view but also be free from baked-in lighting and geometric distortion, capturing the garment’s intrinsic albedo. However, current state-of-the-art 3D texturing frameworks ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023a ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ) typically rely on multi-view diffusion priors to iteratively “paint” assets via direct projection onto draped 3D geometry. Consequently, unwrapping these folded surfaces inevitably causes large geometric distortion and occlusion. Furthermore, these models fail to disentangle intrinsic material properties from environmental illumination, baking transient lighting artifacts, such as shadows and geometry-induced wrinkles, directly into the texture map.
blocks.zh: 服装纹理合成由于织物的动力学复杂而特别困难,织物经常产生深层折叠,自闭,极致产生变化(见图1). 为了真正能够用于下游应用,纹理不仅必须在静态的视野中看起来现实,还必须远离烤制的照明和几何扭曲,抓住服装固有的反照率。 然而,目前最先进的3D文本化框架(Richardson等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年a年;Zeng等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年;Bensadoun等人,2024年)通常依赖多视图传播的前身,通过直接投影到3D几何上来迭代“涂抹”资产。 因此,将这些折叠的表面拆开,不可避免地会造成大的几何扭曲和封存。 此外,这些模型未能将环境照明、烘焙瞬态照明文物,如阴影和几何引起的皱纹等内在物质特性直接分解到纹理图中。

blocks.en:
To circumvent these issues, recent work such as FabricDiffusion ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) has explored texture synthesis directly within the regularized, flat 2D sewing pattern domain, successfully yielding simulation-ready texture maps.
However, FabricDiffusion focuses exclusively on local texture synthesis by extracting tileable material patches from the source image, ignoring the global texture layout. Consequently, it struggles at reconstructing asymmetric designs, large-scale prints, or irregular spatial patterns. We argue that synthesizing a globally coherent texture map that faithfully reflects the visual identity of the input image requires leveraging the complete context of the reference observation, rather than relying on isolated patches. This presents a fundamental challenge: How do we establish pixel-level correspondences between a reference image and 2D sewing panels while transferring textures that are free from baked-in artifacts and geometric distortions?
blocks.zh:
为规避这些问题,FabricDifumation(张等,2024年)等近期工作在规范化,平面2D缝纫图案域内直接探索纹理合成,成功生成模拟准备纹理图.
然而,FabricDifusion完全专注于局部的纹理合成,方法是从源图像中提取可瓦材料补丁,而忽略全球纹理布局. 因此,它难以重建不对称设计、大规模印刷或不规则的空间格局。 我们主张,综合全球一致的纹理图,忠实地反映输入图像的视觉特征,需要利用参考观测的完整背景,而不是依赖孤立的补丁. 这是一项根本性的挑战: 我们如何建立参考图像和2D缝纫面板之间的像素级对应,同时传输没有烘烤文物和几何扭曲的纹理?

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose OmniFabric to bridge this gap. We first employ a powerful image generation model ( Google, 2025 ) to repose the input clothing into a canonical A-pose, aligning its silhouette with the frontal render of the garment mesh simulated from the predicted sewing patterns. We further harness the temporal and spatial consistency of large-scale video generation models ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) to hallucinate coherent, multi-view observations of this A-pose garment. Projecting these globally consistent multi-view images onto the unwrapped sewing patterns establishes a complete, albeit coarse, texture initialization that preserves the garment’s global design. Because this initial projection inevitably bakes visual artifacts such as geometric distortions and physics-induced wrinkles into the texture map, we introduce a subsequent refinement stage operating entirely within the sewing pattern space. We design an automatic data engine that curates an extensive and highly diverse synthetic dataset of textured sewing patterns, paired with simulated texture initializations containing baked-in artifacts and distortions. With the curated dataset, we train a specialized Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that acts as a texture normalizer in the 2D sewing pattern space. This model rectifies distortions, and strips away transient illumination to produce a clean and normalized texture map. Finally, we conduct comprehensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority of OmniFabric over existing 3D texturing baselines. In summary, the key contributions of our work are: • OmniFabric, a novel framework for synthesizing high-fidelity, globally coherent textures from a single in-the-wild image for 3D garment reconstruction. • An automated data engine for creating realistic, diverse textured sewing patterns at scale, providing training data for learning complex garment textures. • A strategy of using a canonical 3D mesh as spatial anchor to map image pixels to sewing pattern UV space, enabling globally aligned texture synthesis. • A coarse-to-fine texture generation pipeline that initializes globally aligned textures, and further rectifies distortion and baked-in artifacts with a DiT-based UV space normalization network.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议OmniFabric弥补这一差距。 我们首先使用强大的图像生成模型(Google, 2025年), 将输入衣物重新放入犬形A-pose, 我们进一步利用大型视频生成模型的时间和空间一致性(Google DeepMind, 2025年), 来幻化对这件A-pose服装的连贯,多视图观测. 将这些全球一致的多视图图像投射到未包装的缝纫图案上,可以建立完整但粗糙的纹理初始化,保留服装的全球设计。 由于这种初始投影不可避免地将几何扭曲和物理引起的皱纹等视觉文物烤入纹理图中,因此我们引入了之后完全在缝纫图案空间内运行的精细阶段. 我们设计了一个自动数据引擎,它可以解析一个广泛和高度多样化的合成数据集,其中包含纹理缝纫图案,并配以包含烤制文物和扭曲的模拟纹理初始化. 利用整理的数据集,我们培训了一台专门的传播变形器(DiT),在2D缝纫图案空间中起到纹理正常化的作用. 这个模型纠正了扭曲,并剥离了瞬变的光线,以产生一个干净和正常化的纹理图. 最后,我们进行全面实验,以显示OmniFabric优于现有的3D纹理基线。 简而言之,我们工作的主要贡献是: · OmniFabric,是合成高纯度,全球一致的纹理的一个新框架,它来自三维服装重建的单一内在形象. 一个自动数据引擎,用于在规模上创造现实,多样的纹理缝纫模式,为学习复杂的服装纹理提供培训数据. • 支助 采用犬形3D网格作为空间锚点的策略,将图像像素映射到缝纫图案紫外线空间,实现全球对齐的纹理合成. ^ 粗到细的纹理生成管道,将全球对齐的纹理初始化,并用基于DiT的紫外线空间正常化网络进一步校正扭曲和烤制文物.

blocks.en: Generating 3D garment textures is not a new topic. While many prior works mainly focus on directly texturing 3D garment meshes, they often do not scale well to large collections of in-the-wild images and remain weakly connected to real-world garment production pipelines. We argue that fabric texture synthesis should be grounded in the UV space of sewing patterns. This enables the model to maintain strong global coherence while remaining closely aligned with how garments are constructed in practice.
blocks.zh: 生成3D服装纹理不是一个新话题. 虽然之前的许多作品主要侧重于直接纹理3D服装网格,但往往不能很好地扩展到大量收集的闪闪发光的图像上,而且仍然与现实世界的服装生产管道连接薄弱. 我们主张,织物纹理合成应建立在缝纫模式的紫外空间中. 这使得该模式能够保持强有力的全球一致性,同时保持与实际服装构造方法的紧密一致。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. 3D Garment Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1. 国家 三维服装重建

blocks.en:
Early approaches for garment reconstruction primarily relied on implicit functions ( Saito et al., 2019 ; Saito et al., 2020 ; Xiu et al., 2022 ) to approximate surfaces, yet they often struggle with complex topologies and loose-fitting clothing. More recent works leverage advanced representations like 3DGS ( Rong et al., 2025 ) and image-to-3D diffusion priors ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) to achieve impressive visual fidelity. However, these methods typically produce rigid meshes or unstructured point clouds that are inherently unsuitable for physical cloth simulation. While methods like Garment3DGen ( Sarafianos et al., 2025 ) bridge this gap by utilizing template deformation to produce simulation-ready assets, they rely on a slow, computationally intensive per-asset optimization process.
To obtain simulation-ready assets, a significant line of work attempts to infer 2D sewing patterns directly from 3D point clouds or images. NeuralTailor ( Korosteleva and Lee, 2022 ) focused on reconstructing pattern structures from 3D geometry, and subsequent works ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) predict these patterns directly from single-view images using discriminative transformer architectures. To facilitate more structured generation, GarmentCode ( Korosteleva and Sorkine-Hornung, 2023 ) introduced a programmatic domain-specific language (DSL) for sewing patterns, enabling parametric control. Building on this representation, subsequent research has increasingly focused on advanced generative modeling. DressCode ( He et al., 2024 ) synthesizes novel patterns from text prompts using a GPT-based framework, while AIpparel ( Nakayama et al., 2025 ) scales into a multimodal foundation model that handles complex pattern generation natively from mixed inputs. To further improve physical realism, Dress-1-to-3 ( Li et al., 2025b ) incorporates differentiable physics simulators to optimize geometric alignment of the inferred patterns. Concurrently, other state-of-the-art frameworks directly predict these programmatic structures from images leveraging large generative models ( Bian et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . While these methods have established sewing patterns as a robust domain for 3D animation, the synthesis of normalized, artifact-free textures for these panels remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh:
早期的服装重建方法主要依靠隐含的功能(Saito等人,2019年;Saito等人,2020年;Xiu等人,2022年)来近似表面,然而它们却经常与复杂的地形和松散的服装纠缠. 更近期的作品利用了3DGS(Rong等人,2025年)和图像到3D传播前传(Wang等人,2025年;Luo等人,2024年)等高级表述,实现令人印象深刻的视觉忠诚. 然而,这些方法通常会产生硬质的网点或无结构的点云,而这些点云本质上不适合物理布料模拟. Garment3DGen(Sarafianos等人,2025年)等方法通过利用模板变形产生模拟准备资产来弥补这一差距,但它们依赖于缓慢的、计算密集的每个资产优化过程。
为了获得模拟准备资产,大量工作试图直接从3D点云或图像推断2D缝纫模式. 神经泰洛尔(Korosteleva and Lee,2022年)专注于从3D几何重建图案结构,之后的作品(Liu等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年)利用歧义变压器架构直接从单视图像中预测这些图案. 为了方便更有条理的生成,GarmentCode(Korosteleva和Sorkine-Hornung,2023年)引入了用于缝纫图案的方案域专用语言(DSL),实现了参数控制. 在此基础上,随后的研究越来越注重先进的基因模型。 DressCode(He et al., 2024)利用基于GBT的框架从文本提示中合成了新颖模式,而AIpparel(中山等人,2025年)则将比例尺转化为多式联运基础模型,从混合投入中本土处理复杂的模式生成. 为了进一步改善物理现实主义,Dress-1至3(Li等人,2025年b)采用了不同的物理模拟器,以优化推断规律的几何对齐. 同时,其他最先进的框架利用大型基因模型的图像直接预测这些方案结构(Bian等人,2025年;周等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年a). 虽然这些方法将缝纫模式确立为3D动画的强力领域,但对这些面板进行正常的无文物纹理的合成仍然是一个公开的挑战.

blocks.en: 2.2. Generative 3D Texturing
blocks.zh: 2.2. 基因3D纹理

blocks.en: The rise of large-scale vision-language models ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) has revolutionized 3D texture synthesis. Early optimization-based approaches either leverage CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) for optimizing texture maps of 3D models ( Hong et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Michel et al., 2022 ; Mohammad Khalid et al., 2022 ) , or employ Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) to optimize texture maps by distilling gradients from a frozen 2D diffusion model ( Poole et al., 2022 ; Metzer et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023b ) . While capable of generating coherent global structures, these methods tend to hallucinate generic textures without high-frequency details. To improve fidelity, recent research has shifted toward projection-based inpainting, by utilizing depth-conditioned Stable Diffusion to progressively paint 3D meshes from multiple viewpoints ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023a ; Cao et al., 2023 ) . These frameworks iteratively project the current texture into screen space, inpaint missing regions using 2D priors, and project the result back. More recent systems like Paint3D ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , MVPaint ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) and Meta 3D TextureGen ( Bensadoun et al., 2024 ) further refine this process by synchronizing multi-view generation or employing coarse-to-fine UV refinement to minimize seams. Despite their popularity, a fundamental limitation persists across these general-purpose methods: they rely on priors trained on natural photography. Consequently, they inherently entangle illumination with surface appearance, inevitably “baking in” transient lighting effects—such as cast shadows and specular highlights—directly into the UV map. In addition, the generated textures are subject to distortion and blurring due to the complex surface topology, leading to suboptimal results.
blocks.zh: 大规模视觉语言模型的兴起(拉德福德等人,2021年;隆巴赫等人,2022年;萨哈里亚等人,2022年)使3D纹理合成发生了革命性的变化. 基于早期优化的方法或者利用CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)优化3D模型的纹理图(Hong等人,2022年;Chen等人,2022年;Michel等人,2022年;Mohammad Khalid等人,2022年),或者利用SDS通过从冷冻的2D扩散模型中提取梯度来优化纹理图(Poole等人,2022年;Metzer等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年b年)。 这些方法虽然能够产生连贯的全球结构,但往往会产生没有高频细节的通用纹理的幻觉. 为了提高忠诚度,最近的研究已经转向了以投影为基础的油漆,利用深层条件的稳定散射,逐步从多个角度绘制立体膜(Richardson等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023a年;Cao等人,2023年)。 这些框架迭代地将当前纹理投射到屏幕空间中,使用2D前缀插入缺失区域,并将结果投射回. 更近代的系统如Paint3D(Zeng等人,2024年),MVPaint(Cheng等人,2025年)和Meta 3D TextureGen(Bensadoun等人,2024年)通过同步多视图生成或采用粗对细紫外线改进来将缝合最小化,来进一步完善这一过程. 尽管这些方法很受欢迎,但这些通用方法仍然存在根本的局限性:它们依赖经过自然摄影培训的前科。 因此,它们内在的将照明与表面外观缠绕在一起,不可避免地将瞬时的照明效果——例如投影和光谱亮度——直接插入紫外线地图。 此外,由于地表地形复杂,生成的纹理会被扭曲和模糊,导致结果不理想.

blocks.en: In the specific area of garment texturing, FabricDiffusion ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) addresses some of these pitfalls by treating texture synthesis as a material extraction task. It utilizes a diffusion model to extract tileable, distortion-free material patches from a single image without lighting artifacts. However, because it relies on local texture tiling, FabricDiffusion fails to capture global structural information, such as specific graphic placements and non-uniform texture patterns across different UV islands. OmniFabric bridges this gap by shifting from local material extraction to global texture synthesis. We operate in the canonical UV space to disentangle base-color from illumination, synthesizing a holistic texture map that respects the global texture design in the reference image. While previous methods ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ) also deploy a 2D refinement stage on the UV map, they only perform inpainting on occluded regions and fail to rectify distortion or remove baked-in artifacts, which are the domain specific challenges for garment texturing, as shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 在服装纹理的具体领域,FabricDifusion(张等,2024年)通过将纹理合成作为材料提取任务来处理其中一些陷阱. 它利用一种扩散模型从单一的图像中提取可瓦的、无扭曲的材料补丁,而无需照明文物。 然而,由于它依赖于当地的纹理板块,FabricDifusion未能捕捉到全球结构信息,例如不同紫外线岛屿上的具体图形定位和非统一纹理模式. OmniFabric通过从局部物质提取到全球纹理合成来弥补这一差距. 我们运行在 canonical UV空间,将底色与照明分开,合成一个尊重参考图像中全球纹理设计的整体纹理图. 虽然以往的方法(Zeng等人,2024年;Bensadoun等人,2024年)也在紫外线地图上部署了一个2D的改进阶段,但它们只在被渗透的区域进行涂抹,未能纠正扭曲或移除烘焙的文物,这是服装纹理的具体领域挑战,如图2所示.

blocks.en: Figure 2. Limits of baseline texturing methods. blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3. Overview of OmniFabric. Given a reference clothing image, OmniFabric synthesizes high-quality garment textures in sewing pattern UV space via a two-stage pipeline. Stage 1: We generate a coarse UV texture map by first predicting garment sewing patterns and reconstructing a canonical 3D garment. The input image texture is transferred onto the garment surface and expanded into multi-view using an off-the-shelf video generative model. These views are projected onto the canonical garment and reflected in UV space to produce a globally aligned coarse texture map. Stage 2: We refine the coarse texture with a DiT-based texture normalization network operating on UV patches. By conditioning on positional maps and spatially aligned tokens, the model removes baked-in artifacts and projection inconsistencies, producing clean and coherent sewing pattern textures that can be directly simulated into 3D garments. A figure showing the overall pipeline of our method.
blocks.zh: 图 3. OmniFabric概览。 由于有参考服装图像,OmniFabric通过两阶段管道在缝纫图案紫外线空间中合成高质量的服装纹理. 阶段 1:我们通过首先预测服装缝纫模式,重建犬齿3D服装,生成粗糙的紫外线纹理图. 输入图像纹理被转移到服装表面,并利用现成的视频基因模型扩展成多视图。 这些观点被投射到峡谷服装上,并反映在紫外线空间中,以绘制出全球一致的粗纹图。 阶段 2: 我们用一个在紫外线补丁上运行的基于DiT的纹理正常化网络来完善粗质纹理. 该模型通过在位置图和空间对齐的标志上进行调制,消除了烤制的文物和投影的不一致之处,产生了干净而连贯的缝纫图案纹理,可以直接模拟成3D服装. 一个显示我们方法总体管道的数字。

blocks.en: Figure 3 presents an overview of our approach. We aim to reconstruct 3D garments with coherent textures from real-world images. We define the task and objective in Section 3.1 . Next, we introduce a two-stage pipeline for generating holistic textures directly onto sewing patterns. This includes a coarse texture map initialization (Section 3.2 ) and a UV space texture normalization (Section 3.3 ). To train the model, we develop an automated pipeline to synthesize a large scale dataset of textured sewing patterns (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 图3概述了我们的做法。 我们的目标是从现实世界的图像中用连贯的纹理重建3D服装. 我们在第3.1节中确定了任务和目标。 接下来,我们引入一个两阶段的管道, 以产生整体的纹理 直接到缝纫模式。 这包括粗质纹理图初始化(第3.2节)和紫外线空间纹理正常化(第3.3节)。 为了培训该模型,我们开发了一个自动管道,以合成一个大尺度的纹理缝纫图案数据集(第4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1. Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1. 问题定义

blocks.en:
Given a single reference image I I and an estimated 3D garment mesh ℳ ℛ \mathcal{M_{R}} parameterized by sewing patterns 𝒫 \mathcal{P} from an off-the-shelf sewing pattern prediction model, our goal is to generate a normalized texture map 𝒯 \mathcal{T} directly within the sewing pattern space.
Unlike previous methods ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) that focus on extracting local and repeatable material patches, we formulate our objective as a global texture synthesis task. We define 𝒯 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathcal{T}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} as a representation of the normalized texture map of the garment, which is completely free of distortion, view-dependent illumination, cast shadows, and geometry-induced wrinkles. Following the paradigm of diffusion models, we formulate the synthesis of this holistic texture map as a conditional distribution mapping problem. We seek to learn a mapping function 𝒢 \mathcal{G} such that: (1) 𝒯 ∼ 𝒢 ⁡ ( ℐ , 𝒫 , ϵ ) , ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 𝐈 ) \mathcal{T}\sim\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{I},\mathcal{P},\epsilon),\epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I})

blocks.en: 3.2. Coarse Texture Map Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.2. 粗质地图初始化

blocks.en: To guide texture synthesis in the sewing pattern space, we first aim to obtain a coarse texture initialization that fully leverages the visual information from the reference image. This requires establishing pixel-wise correspondences between the reference image and the sewing pattern. While this mapping is challenging, we recast the task via a VLM-driven and pose aware texture alignment step. We further leverage the multi-view generative priors of large video models to provide a complete and globally coherent texture initialization.
blocks.zh: 为了指导缝纫图案空间的纹理合成,我们首先的目标是获得粗细的纹理初始化,充分利用来自参考图像的视觉信息. 这就需要在参考图像和缝纫模式之间建立像素相对应. 虽然这种绘图具有挑战性,但我们通过由VLM驱动的重构任务,并形成有意识的纹理对齐步骤. 我们进一步利用大型视频模型的多视图遗传学前科,提供完整和全球一致的纹理初始化。

blocks.en: 3.2.1. Pose aware texture alignment
blocks.zh: 3.2.1. 联合国 触觉纹理对齐

This alignment enables direct pixel projection of I ′ I^{\prime} onto ℳ R \mathcal{M}_{R} and its corresponding sewing patterns 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , producing the textured frontal render R f R_{f} . We observe that Nano Banana Pro successfully manipulates the input garment into a desired pose while preserving the original texture with high accuracy and fidelity.

blocks.en: 3.2.2. Consistent multi-view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 3.2.2. 一致的多观点综合。

blocks.en: After the initial pose alignment, a significant portion of the UV space occluded from the frontal view remains untextured. To hallucinate these missing regions while encouraging strong spatial continuity, we leverage a large-scale video generation model for multi-view generation. By conditioning the model on the textured frontal render R f R_{f} , we synthesize a 360-degree spinning video of the garment, naturally exploiting the model’s inherent temporal priors for structural consistency. Following recent projection-based texturing paradigms, we sample multi-view V V , four orthogonal views (front, back, left, and right) from the generated video. These observations are then projected onto ℳ R \mathcal{M}_{R} and mapped to their corresponding UV coordinates on 𝒫 \mathcal{P} to form the coarse texture map 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T}^{\prime} .
blocks.zh: 最初摆放对齐后,从前视线上占据的紫外线空间中,仍有相当一部分没有纹理. 为了幻觉这些缺失区域,同时鼓励强大的空间连续性,我们利用一个大规模视频生成模型来进行多视图生成. 通过在纹理前部对模型进行定型,我们合成了360度旋转的服装视频,自然利用模型固有的时间前兆来保持结构一致性。 继最近基于投影的纹理范式之后,我们从生成的视频中抽取了多视图V V,四个正交视图(前,后,左,右). 这些观测结果随后被投射到M R\ mathcal{M}_{R}上,并映射到P\mathcal{P}上相应的紫外线坐标,以形成粗纹理图 T '\ mathcal{T}^{\prime}.

blocks.en: 3.3. UV Space Texture Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.3. 紫外线空间纹理改进

blocks.en: While 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T^{\prime}} preserves the coherent global texture of the garment, it contains baked-in artifacts like shadows, physical wrinkles and unpainted areas. Furthermore, spatial distortions in 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T^{\prime}} leave it far short of production-ready fabric quality, as shown in Figure 2 . To address these issues, we introduce a texture normalization model designed to rectify 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T^{\prime}} into a normalized texture map 𝒯 \mathcal{T} .

blocks.en: 3.3.1. Training objective of multi-condition diffusion
blocks.zh: 3.3.1. 运输 多条件传播的培训目标

Unlike FabricDiffusion ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , which relies on a single condition, i.e., a local textile patch, for the normalization task, our framework incorporates a multimodal conditioning set y y to guide global texture normalization. blocks.en: 3.3.2. Model architecture and training
blocks.zh: 3.3.2. 示范架构和培训

blocks.en: To process multimodal conditioning set y y , we adopt a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture following previous works ( Tan et al., 2025a ; Tan et al., 2025b ) , and leverage a unified token-processing strategy that treats all conditions as a unified sequence of tokens. We utilize a joint self-attention mechanism where the condition tokens (from 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T}^{\prime} , R f R_{f} , and P p ​ o ​ s P_{pos} ) and the noisy latent tokens from z t z_{t} interact within the same transformer blocks. Because 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T}^{\prime} , P p ​ o ​ s P_{pos} , and the target 𝒯 \mathcal{T} all share the same 2D panel layout, we apply a dynamic positional encoding strategy: image patches at the same spatial coordinates across these maps are assigned identical positional encodings, while only R f R_{f} retains its own coordinate system through distinct encodings. This minimal yet universal design allows the model to attend to the structural cues of P p ​ o ​ s P_{pos} while simultaneously hallucinating missing textures in 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T}^{\prime} . We use a pretrained weight of DiT, and fine-tune the model on our synthetic textured sewing pattern data with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了处理多模式调制器 y ,我们采用了之前的作品(Tan等人,2025年a); Tan et al., 2025b ),并发挥统一符号处理策略的作用,将所有条件作为统一符号序列. 我们使用一种联合自我注意机制,即条件符号(来自T '\ mathcal{T}^{\prime}、R f_{f}和P p o s_{pos})和来自z t_{t}的噪音潜伏符号在同一变压器块内相互作用。 由于T '\ mathcal{T}^{\prime},P p o s P_{pos},以及目标T\mathcal{T}都共享相同的2D面板布局,我们采用了动态位置编码策略:在这些地图上相同的空间坐标上的图像补丁被分配到相同的位置编码,而只有R f_{f}通过不同的编码保留了自己的坐标系统. 这种最小但通用的设计允许模型注意 P p o s P_{pos} 的结构提示, 同时在 T \ mathcal{ T}^{\prime} 中幻觉缺失的纹理 。 并用LORA(Hu等人, 2022年)对模型进行微调。

blocks.en: 4. Synthetic Training Data Creation
blocks.zh: 4. 合成培训数据创建

blocks.en: To train our texture normalization model, we develop a data engine (Figure 4 ) to curate a large-scale dataset of textured sewing patterns. The core objective is to synthesize training pairs that exhibit the complex appearance of real-world garments while providing ground-truth normalized texture maps for supervised learning.
blocks.zh: 为了训练我们的纹理正常化模型,我们开发了一个数据引擎(图4),以校验一个大规模的纹理缝纫模式数据集. 核心目标是综合显示现实世界服装复杂外观的训练配对,同时提供地面真实的正常纹理图,用于有监督的学习。

blocks.en: 4.1. Textured Sewing Pattern Creation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 纹理缝纫模式的创造

blocks.en: A key bottleneck in garment dataset construction is the lack of complex and high-resolution textures; most available texture sources provide only simple, repetitive patterns. To overcome this, we introduce a pipeline to produce diverse, high-fidelity texture images by using fashion images from real-world datasets, e.g., DeepFashion ( Liu et al., 2016 ) , as references. For each sample, we apply a Large Language Model (LLM) ( Bai et al., 2023 ) to generate a detailed description encompassing texture layout, semantic elements, and color palettes. These descriptions, combined with the reference image, are fed into a vision-language model ( Google, 2025 ) to synthesize textures with diverse designs. We then overlay the generated texture image onto sewing patterns sampled from GarmentCodeData. Note that the goal here is not to reconstruct the exact texture from the example image, but to generate plausible and realistic textures that provide sufficient diversity for training the texture synthesis model.
blocks.zh: 服装数据集构建中的一个关键瓶颈是缺乏复杂和高分辨率的纹理;大多数可用的纹理来源只能提供简单,重复的模式. 为了克服这一点,我们引入了一条管道,通过使用来自现实世界数据集的时尚图像,例如DeepFashion(Liu等人,2016年),来制作多样化的,高真实度的纹理图像,作为参考. 对于每个样本,我们采用一个大语言模型(LLM)(Bai等人,2023年)来生成一个包含纹理布局,语义元素,和色调板的详细描述. 这些描述与参考图像相结合,被输入一个视觉语言模型(Google,2025),以合成各种设计中的纹理. 然后我们把生成的纹理图像 覆盖到从GarmentCodeData样本中提取的缝纫图案上。 请注意,这里的目标不是从示例图像中重建准确的纹理,而是产生可信和现实的纹理,为训练纹理合成模型提供足够的多样性.

blocks.en: 5. Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.五. 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we present a comprehensive evaluation of OmniFabric through quantitative and qualitative analyses. We first detail the experimental setup, including curated synthetic dataset and metrics used for evaluation. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework by comparing against SOTA methods for 3D texturing. Finally, we conduct ablation studies to validate our core architectural designs. Additional implementation details, extended qualitative results, our method’s adaptability to other sewing pattern prediction methods besides ChatGarment ( Bian et al., 2025 ) , examples of our curated garment data, and discussion on potential future directions are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们通过定量和定性分析,对OmniFabric作了全面评估。 我们首先详细介绍了实验设置,包括用于评价的精密合成数据集和衡量标准。 然后,我们通过比较3D文本化的SOTA方法来展示我们的框架的有效性. 最后,我们进行消化研究,验证我们的核心建筑设计。 除了ChatGarment(Bian等人,2025年)之外,我们的方法对其它缝纫模式预测方法的适应性、我们整理的服装数据的例子以及未来可能的方向的讨论都载于补充材料。

blocks.en: 5.1. Setup
5.1.1. Datasets

To train and evaluate our model, we construct a large-scale synthetic dataset of textured sewing patterns, as described in Section 4 . We sample a total of 3K unique and diverse garment samples from GarmentCodeData ( Korosteleva et al., 2024 ) . We then use the pipeline in Figure 4 to generate texture images, and print them onto sampled sewing patterns, finally constructing a dataset of 30K textured sewing patterns with diverse appearances and structural designs (10 texture variations per garment style on average). We simulate garments using NVIDIA Warp ( Macklin, 2022 ) with a per-sample random seed, so repeated simulations of the same sewing pattern produce distinct ℳ R \mathcal{M}_{R} meshes and, consequently, different baked-in wrinkles in 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T}^{\prime} . For lighting, we sample random subsets of white point lights to introduce varied illumination and baked-in shading across the dataset. We train our model with this synthetic dataset, and keep a held-out set for quantitative comparison with other baseline models with a test/train ratio of 0.1. Besides synthetic data, we evaluate all methods on in-the-wild images, which is the major focus of this work. These in-the-wild images are obtained from DeepFashion ( Liu et al., 2016 ) dataset and recent clothing-design images collected from the web. Due to the lack of ground truth in-the-wild images, we evaluate mainly through qualitative comparisons.
blocks.zh: 为了训练和评价我们的模型,我们建造了一个大规模合成数据集,如第4节所述。 我们从GarmentCodeData(Korosteleva等人,2024年)抽取了3K种独特多样的服装样本。 然后,我们利用图4中的管道生成纹理图像,并将其打印到抽样的缝纫图案上,最后构建了一个由30K纹理缝纫图案组成的数据集,其外观和结构设计各异(平均每件服装样式10种纹理变化)。 我们用NVIDIA WARP(Macklin, 2022年)模拟服装, 并用每个样本的随机种子, 在照明方面,我们抽取了随机的白点灯子,以便引入各种照明和整个数据集的烘烤阴影。 我们用这个合成数据集来训练我们的模型,并保留一套用于与其他基线模型进行定量比较的模型,试验/火车比为0.1。 除了合成数据之外,我们还评估了全局图像上的所有方法,这是这项工作的主要重点. 这些内幕图像来自DeepFashion(Liu等人,2016年)数据集和最近从网络采集的服装设计图像. 由于缺乏地面真实性,我们主要通过质量比较来评估。

blocks.en: 5.1.2. Metrics

We evaluate fidelity and structural coherence of the generated textures with a suite of standard metrics. We use LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and DISTS ( Ding et al., 2020 ) to measure visual similarity and structural consistency. We also compare with SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) and MS-SSIM ( Wang et al., 2003 ) , metrics employed to assess pixel-level structural accuracy. CLIP-score (CLIP-s) ( Gal et al., 2022 ) measures the semantic alignment between the final textured garment and the reference images.
blocks.zh: 我们用一套标准衡量标准来评价生成的纹理的忠诚性和结构一致性。 我们使用LPIPS(张等,2018年)和DISTS(丁等,2020年)测量视觉相似性和结构一致性. 我们还与SSIM(Wang等人,2004年)和MS-SSIM(Wang等人,2003年)进行了比较,后者是用来评估像素级结构精度的衡量标准。 CLIP-分数(CLIP-s)(Gal等人,2022年)测量最终纹饰服装与参考图像之间的语义一致.

blocks.en: 5.1.3. Baseline methods
blocks.zh: 5.1.3. 基准方法

blocks.en: We compare against several SOTA methods in 3D texturing and garment-specific texture transfer. Among them, Hunyuan3D-2.0 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and Paint3D ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) use multi-view generation to provide additional prior beyond the given single-view observation. FabricDiffusion ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) is capable of creating fabric textures with no baked-in artifacts by normalizing local textile patterns with a diffusion model.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了3D纹理和服装特异纹理转移中的几种SOTA方法. 其中,Hunyuan3D-2.0(Zhao等人,2025年)和Paint3D(Zeng等人,2024年)使用多视图生成法在给定的单视图观察之外提供额外的前置. 纤维扩散 (Zhang等人,2024年)通过以扩散模型使当地纺织图案正常化,能够创造无烤制文物的织物纹理.

blocks.en: 5.1.4. Implementation details
blocks.zh: 5.1.4. 实施细节

blocks.en: Figure 5. Qualitative results of OmniFabric. Our method synthesizes 3D garments with high appearance consistency by predicting sewing patterns of normalized textures. In particular, OmniFabric handles intrinsic geometric distortions and reconstructs diverse texture types, including logos and printed graphics (1st and 2nd rows), and complex high-frequency patterns with dense visual details. Please zoom in to check the details. A figure showing the qualitative results.
blocks.zh: 图 5. OmniFabric的质量结果。 我们的方法通过预测正常纹理的缝纫规律,将外观一致性高的3D服装合成. 特别是OmniFabric处理内在几何扭曲,并重建各种纹理类型,包括标志和印刷图形(1和2行),以及具有密集视觉细节的复杂高频图案. 请放大看看细节 显示质量结果的数字。

blocks.en: Figure 6. Qualitative comparisons to state-of-the-art methods. OmniFabric is capable of generating accurate asymmetric textures and logos, while existing methods fail to preserve the high-frequency details on input cases with complex patterns. A figure showing the qualitative comparisons among baselines.
blocks.zh: 图 6. 与最新方法进行定性比较。 OmniFabric能够生成准确的不对称纹理和标志,而现有的方法无法保存具有复杂规律的输入案例的高频细节. 显示基线之间质量比较的数字。

blocks.en: Our texture normalization model is based on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture, and we follow the multi-conditioning strategy of OminiControl ( Tan et al., 2025a ) by treating tokens from all input conditions as a unified token sequence. The model is fine-tuned using LoRA on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU with a batch size of 8, keeping the VAE and primary DiT backbone fixed to preserve generative stability. We resize and pad sewing pattern maps to a resolution of 1024 × \times 1024 in a batch for training efficiency. During inference, we reverse the padding and resizing process, and deploy an image super-resolution model ( Wang et al., 2021 ) to upscale the output. Since we are fine-tuning the model with LoRA, a higher training resolution can be easily achieved without GPU memory issues, making our framework scalable for training data of higher resolution. We fine-tune the model until convergence on our synthetic dataset. We utilize Veo 3 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) as the multi-view video generation prior and Nano Banana Pro ( Google, 2025 ) for the initial texture transfer to the frontal rendering R f R_{f} . We used ChatGarment ( Bian et al., 2025 ) as the model for sewing pattern prediction throughout all experiments in the main paper. The average runtime for a single inference is roughly 5 minutes, depending on the current load on the Gemini model servers. The failure rate of Gemini models, e.g., generating unrelated textures on R f R_{f} or multi-views, is lower than 2%, estimated from randomly sampled generations. No additional filtering is necessary thanks to its stable performance. Additional details including prompts used for generation are provided in supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们的纹理正常化模型基于扩散变形器(DiT)架构,我们遵循Omini Control(Tan等人,2025a)的多空调策略,将来自所有输入条件的代号作为统一的代号序列. 该模型在单NVIDIA A6000GPU上使用LORA进行微调,批量尺寸为8,保持VAE和主DiT骨干固定,以保持基因稳定性. 为了提高训练效率,我们把缝纫图的大小调整为1024x\时的1024分。 在推论中,我们反转了粘贴和缩放过程,并部署一个图像超解析模型(Wang等人,2021年)来提升输出. 由于我们正与LORA一起对模型进行微调,在没有GPU内存问题的情况下,可以很容易地实现更高的培训分辨率,使我们的培训数据框架具有更高的分辨率. 我们微调模型,直到我们合成的数据集汇合。 我们利用Veo 3(Google DeepMind, 2025年)作为多视图视频生成, 我们用ChatGarment(Bian等人,2025年)作为主论文中所有实验的缝纫模式预测模型. 单一推论的平均运行时间约为5分钟,这取决于双子座模型服务器上的当前负荷. 双子座模型的故障率,如在R f RQQf}或多视图上生成不相关的纹理,低于2%,从随机抽样的代数中估计. 由于其稳定的性能,不需要额外的过滤. 补充材料中提供了更多细节,包括用于生成的提示。

blocks.en: 5.2. Qualitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.2. 定性比较

blocks.en: 5.2.1. Texture synthesis by OmniFabric from in-the-wild images
blocks.zh: 5.2.1. (中文(简体) ). 由 OmniFabric 从模糊的图像中合成纹理

blocks.en: We first show our results in Figure 5 . Given a reference image, OmniFabric first generates a coarse texture map, serving as a roughly textured sewing pattern. Then, the texture normalization model removes the distortions and baked-in artifacts. From the front views of simulated 3D garments provided in Figure 5 , we show that OmniFabric is capable of creating seamless textures across the 3D surface of garments. Note that while OmniFabric excels in textured garment synthesis from real-world images, we fine-tune our model only with synthetic data, which poses great scalability for model improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在图5中显示我们的成果。 鉴于参考图像,OmniFabric首先生成粗细的纹理图,作为大致纹理的缝纫图案. 随后,纹理正常化模型消除了扭曲,烤制的文物. 从图5提供的模拟3D服装的正面视图来看,我们显示OmniFabric能够通过服装的3D表面产生无缝纹理. 请注意,OmniFabric从现实世界的图像中精通了纹理服装合成,但我们只用合成数据来微调我们的模型,这为模型的改进提供了极大的可扩展性.

blocks.en: 5.2.2. Simulation results
blocks.zh: 5.2.2. 模拟结果

blocks.en: We present simulations of synthesized 3D garments in Figure 9 via CLO. The sewing patterns generated by OmniFabric provide the normalized RGB base-color as albedo. Other parameters not predicted by our model—roughness, metallic, reflection intensity, and auto-generated normal map—are left at CLO’s default Fabric_Matte preset values. The Environment/HDRI maps for relighting examples are also chosen from CLO’s lighting presets. The simulated assets exhibit a convincing and photorealistic dynamic appearance, maintaining structural integrity and texture coherence even under extreme dynamics and varying illumination.
blocks.zh: 我们通过CLO在图9中展示了合成3D服装的模拟. OmniFabric生成的缝纫图案提供了正常的RGB基色作为反照率. CLO默认的 Fabric_Matte 预设值中还剩下我们模型所未预测的其他参数,如月度、金属、反射强度和自动生成的普通地图。 还从CLO的照明预设中选取环境/HDRI地图来重新点亮实例. 模拟资产表现出令人信服和光现实主义的动态外观,即使在极端动态和不同光照下,也保持结构完整性和纹理一致性。

blocks.en: 5.2.3. Comparison with state-of-the-art methods
blocks.zh: 5.2.3. 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare with other methods in Figure 6 using in-the-wild images as well. For input with complex textures and elements, both Hunyuan3D and Paint3D fail to preserve the high-frequency details. Even though FabricDiffusion can create normalized textile pattern and texture the given mesh by tiling local textile patches, it is limited to local textile patches and fails to generate coherent global appearance. Conversely, OmniFabric creates normalized textures while preserving coherent details.
blocks.zh: 与图6中的其他方法相比,我们也使用了全局图像。 对于带有复杂纹理和元素的输入,Hunyuan3D和Paint3D都未能保存高频细节. 尽管FabricDifumation可以通过铺设局部的纺织补丁来创造正常的纺织图案和纹理给定的网格,但它仅限于局部的纺织补丁,未能产生连贯的全球外观. 反之,OmniFabric在保存连贯细节的同时,创造出正常化的纹理.

blocks.en: 5.3. Quantitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.3. 数量比较

blocks.en: 5.3.1. Synthetic dataset
blocks.zh: 5.3.1. 合成数据集

blocks.en: We show quantitative results where all baselines are evaluated with our curated synthetic dataset for fair comparison. For each test case, we provide every baseline with the identical frontal rendering R f R_{f} and rest-posed mesh ℳ ℛ \mathcal{M_{R}} . Each method then performs its respective 3D texturing task on ℳ ℛ \mathcal{M_{R}} . To compute image-based metrics, the resulting 3D textures are projected back into the sewing pattern UV space to generate a comparable texture map 𝒯 \mathcal{T} for each baseline. Table 1 shows OmniFabric excels in all metrics, particularly in preserving global structural coherence and eliminating projection artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们用我们整理的合成数据集来评价所有基线,以便进行公平比较。 对于每个测试案例, 我们提供每个基线 相同的前置渲染 R f R_{f} 和休息的 mesh M R\ mathcal{ M_{R}} 。 每种方法然后在 M R\ mathcal{MQQR} 上执行各自的 3D 文本化任务 。 为了计算基于图像的度量,所产生的3D纹理被投射回缝纫图案紫外线空间,为每个基线生成可比的纹理图T\mathcal{T}. 表1显示OmniFabric在所有衡量标准方面,特别是在维护全球结构一致性和消除预测文物方面都取得了卓越成绩。

blocks.en: 5.3.2. Real-world data
blocks.zh: 5.3.2. 真实世界数据

blocks.en: Table 1. Quantitative comparisons. We compare with baselines on our synthetic dataset. The results show that OmniFabric greatly surpasses all other methods in terms of both pixel and perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 图表 1. 定量比较。 我们比较了合成数据集的基线。 结果显示,OmniFabric在像素和知觉质量上大大超过了所有其他方法.

blocks.en: Table 2. User study for real-world data. We compare with baselines on real-world input images in 4 aspects: overall quality, fidelity, back-view plausibility and global coherence.
blocks.zh: 表2. 现实世界数据的用户研究。 我们与关于现实世界输入图像的基线在四个方面进行了比较:总体质量、忠诚、后视可信度和全球一致性。

blocks.en: Besides comparing with other methods in Figure 6 , we conduct a user study to evaluate the performances of the methods due to the absence of real-world dataset of textured sewing patterns. As detailed in Table 2 , the study involves 13 participants evaluating results from 10 real-world image inputs based on four criteria: overall quality ranking (1 to 4, lower is better), fidelity to the input appearance, back-view plausibility, and global texture coherence (1 to 5, higher is better). OmniFabric achieves the best results across all criteria, demonstrating that it is preferred on real images and more faithfully preserves coherent garment textures.
blocks.zh: 除了与图6中的其他方法进行比较外,我们进行了用户研究,以评估由于缺乏纹理缝纫模式的现实世界数据集,这些方法的性能. 如表2所详述,该研究涉及13名参与者,根据以下四项标准评价10个真实世界图像投入的结果:总体质量排名(1至4,较低者更好)、对输入外观的忠诚度、后视可信度和全球纹理一致性(1至5,较高者更好)。 OmniFabric在所有标准上都取得了最佳效果,表明在真实的图像上它更受青睐,更忠实地保存了连贯的服装纹理.

blocks.en: 5.4. Reproducibility via Open-Source Models
blocks.zh: 5.4. 通过开放源码模式可复制

blocks.en: Table 3. We construct a fully open-source alternative and it achieves similar performance to the default settings using closed-source models, showing the great reproducibility of our framework.
blocks.zh: 表3. 我们构建一个完全开源的替代方案,使用闭源模型实现与默认设置相似的性能,显示了我们框架的巨大可复制性.

blocks.en: Table 5. Ablation study shows that our designs are essential for the texture normalization model to generate position-aligned details with high fidelity.
blocks.zh: 表5. 偏差研究表明,我们的设计对于纹理正常化模式产生高度忠实的姿势相符合的细节至关重要。

blocks.en: While using Gemini models for pose transfer and multi-view generation (Section 3.2 ) as default implementation of OmniFabric, we further construct a fully open-source alternative to facilitate reproducibility. To replace the closed-source models, we use FLUX.2 ( Labs, 2025 ) as image generation backbone and incorporate Ministral 3 ( Liu et al., 2026 ) for prompt up-sampling. We feed textured frontal view R f R_{f} and silhouettes of four orthogonal views as conditions to generate the multi-view with this alternative. Table 3 shows that open-source alternative achieves similar performance with the same experiment settings in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 在使用双子体模型作为OmniFabric的默认执行来进行转移和多视图生成(第3.2节)的同时,我们进一步构建了一种完全开源的替代品,以便于复制. 为了取代闭源模型,我们使用FLUX.2(Labs,2025)作为图像生成的骨干,并纳入Ministry 3(Liu等人,2026年)进行即时采样. 我们输入纹理前视图 R f R_{f} 和四个正交视图的 silhouettes , 作为用此选项生成多视图的条件 。 表3显示,开源替代品在第5.3节中以相同的实验设置实现类似的性能.

blocks.en: 5.5. Error-Accumulation Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5. 误差累积分析

blocks.en: We analyze error accumulation across modules in our model architecture in this section by progressively replacing intermediate outputs, specifically the reposed reference image I ′ I^{\prime} and generated multi-view V V , with ground-truth counterparts. As shown in Table 4 , settings (a) to (c) accumulate errors across stages including texture projection, pose alignment and multi-view generation, and (d) shows that our normalization model effectively fixes these aggregated artifacts on sewing patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们分析本节中我们模型结构各单元的错误累积,逐步取代中间产出,特别是重置的参考图像I ' I^{\prime},并生成多视图V V ,与地面实况对应。 如表4所示,设置(a)至(c)在包括纹理投射在内的各阶段累积错误,形成对齐和多视图生成,以及(d)显示我们的正常化模式有效地将这些汇总文物固定在缝纫模式上。

blocks.en: 5.6. Ablation Studies and Analyses
blocks.zh: 5.6. 研究与分析

blocks.en: 5.6.1. Importance of the canonical 3D and coarse texture map
blocks.zh: 5.6.1. 舟体3D和粗纹理图的重要性

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 -(a), without the coarse texture map, which serves as the distillation of generative priors, the performance drops significantly. This shows that the projected textures do provide essential guidance for the texture generation. Figure 8 shows that the model is randomly generating textures that “look similar” instead of pixel-aligned content without coarse texture map 𝒯 ′ \mathcal{T^{\prime}} .

blocks.en: 5.6.2. Effect of the frontal view rendering condition

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: We introduce OmniFabric, a novel framework for synthesizing 3D garments with normalized and globally coherent textures. By leveraging large-scale generative priors and training a texture normalization model, we effectively disentangle intrinsic albedo from view-dependent artifacts including baked-in shadows and wrinkles. Our method bridges the gap between single-view observations and simulation-ready 3D assets, maintaining structural integrity across complex sewing patterns. For this study, we focus on the synthesis of sewing patterns with normalized textures within the GarmentCode framework. An immediate and promising extension would be to consider the joint prediction of complete PBR material maps, including roughness, metallic, and normal maps, alongside the albedo. We believe this direction will further enhance the photorealism of the reconstructed garments under diverse environmental lighting, providing even greater utility for immersive digital content creation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍OmniFabric,这是将3D服装与正常化和全球一致的纹理合成的新框架。 通过利用大规模基因学前科和培训纹理正常化模型,我们有效地将内在反照率与依赖景色的文物,包括烘烤的阴影和皱纹分开。 我们的方法弥合了单视观测和模拟准备的立体资产之间的差距,在复杂的缝纫模式中保持结构完整性。 就这项研究而言,我们侧重于将缝纫模式与服装法典框架内的正常纹理结合起来。 立即和有希望的延伸将是考虑联合预测完整的PBR材料地图,包括粗糙度、金属和普通地图,以及反照率图。 我们认为,这一方向将进一步加强在各种环境照明下重建的服装的光现实化,为浸泡性数字内容的创造提供更大的效用。

blocks.en: Supplementary Material A A Details of Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: A. 数据集构建细节

blocks.en: A primary contribution of this work is the automated data engine designed to generate high-fidelity textured sewing patterns. While high-detail manual texturing is possible, the process remains prohibitively time-consuming for large-scale applications. In contrast, our pipeline efficiently produces diverse garment styles and textures with a vast range of complexity, facilitating the construction of digital garment datasets at scale. This automated engine is a core contribution that addresses the scarcity of complex, high-resolution textures in existing garment research. We have included several representative examples in this supplement and will release the full dataset as well as the curation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的一个主要贡献是自动数据引擎,旨在生成高真实度的纹理缝纫模式. 虽然可以进行高细节的人工定型,但对于大规模应用来说,这一过程仍然极为费时。 与此相反,我们的管道高效地生产了各种复杂多样的服装样式和纹理,促进了数字服装数据集的规模建设。 这种自动化引擎是解决现有服装研究中缺乏复杂高分辨率纹理的核心贡献. 我们在这份补编中列举了几个有代表性的例子,并将公布完整的数据集和目录。

blocks.zh: 图S1。 我们合成数据集的数据实例。 我们显示每个数据点的 合成纹理缝纫模式及其模拟的3D服装。 数字显示我们整理的数据集中的几个例子。

blocks.en: A.1. Reordering Sewing Pattern for Texturing
blocks.zh: A.1. 重排纹理缝纫模式

blocks.en:
To align our generation process with real-world manufacturing, we introduce a reordering strategy for sewing pattern layouts. In professional garment construction, textures are often seamless across specific functional groups—such as a large frontal fabric panel—but exhibit discontinuities at structural seams, such as the transition from a sleeve to the chest. These discontinuities arise because 3D-stitched edges are often not geometrically matched in 2D space (e.g., a curved sleeve head joining a straight armhole), necessitating different fabric cuts.
Following these observations, our pipeline first reorders the 2D sewing pattern pieces by merging related panels, such as the front and back pieces of a single sleeve, into unified spatial groups. By overlaying textures onto this reordered 2D layout, we ensure seamless pattern continuity within each functional group while maintaining the realistic texture breaks required for production-ready 3D assets.
blocks.zh:
为了使我们的世代过程与现实世界的制造相协调,我们引入了缝纫图案布局的重排策略. 在专业服装构造中,纹理往往在具体功能组别之间是无缝的——如大型前部布料面板——但在结构缝合处显示出不连续,如从袖子到胸腔的过渡。 出现这些不连续的原因是3D-stitched边缘往往没有在2D空间中几何匹配(例如,一个弯曲的袖子头与直臂孔结合),因此需要不同的织物切除.
在这些观测之后,我们的管道首先通过将单个袖子的前部和后部等相关面板合并为统一的空间组,重新排列2D缝纫图案片段. 通过将纹理覆盖在这个重排的2D布局上,我们确保每个功能组内的无缝图案连续性,同时保持生产准备的3D资产所需的现实纹理断裂.

blocks.en: Supplementary Material B B Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 补充材料B B 其他执行细节

blocks.en: In this section, we provide further technical specifics regarding our texturing pipeline. As detailed in the main paper, we utilize a single-view garment observation to generate a 360-degree rotation video. From this sequence, we extract four keyframes corresponding to the orthogonal front, back, left, and right camera views for the multi-view texture projection process. Given that the video depicts a garment in a canonical A-pose, these four views are sufficient to capture the vast majority of surface details. The rest-posed mesh, ℳ ℛ \mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{R}} , is reconstructed by stitching and draping the predicted sewing patterns onto a A-posed SMPL human body model.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了关于我们纹理管道的进一步技术细节。 如主要论文所详述,我们利用单视服装观察生成360度旋转视频. 从这个序列中,我们为多视图纹理投影过程提取了四个对应于正交前,后,左,右相机的键框视图. 由于视频描绘的是一条犬甲A-pose的衣物,这四种观点足以捕捉绝大多数的表面细节. 休养的网格(M R \ mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{R}})是通过缝合和将预言的缝纫图案拉入A-posed SMPL人体模型来重建的.

blocks.en: B.1. Non-overlapping Texture Projection
blocks.zh: B.1. 非重叠纹理投射

blocks.en: A key distinction between our projection method and state-of-the-art baselines, such as Hunyuan3D-2.0, lies in the source and application of multi-view data. While traditional methods project independent images generated by multi-view diffusion models, we project selected frames from a structurally consistent video prior using a specialized non-overlapping strategy. We observe that while multi-view diffusion models improve cross-view alignment, they often sacrifice high-frequency details to maintain that consistency. To preserve these details, our non-overlapping strategy begins by projecting textures from the front and back views—the two perspectives with minimal observational overlap—directly onto the mesh. Subsequently, textures from the side views are projected exclusively onto previously untextured regions, effectively performing a projection-based inpainting. Finally, our data-driven texture normalization model rectifies any minor artifacts or discontinuities at the seams of these projected textures. This approach allows OmniFabric to retain intricate, high-frequency surface details while ensuring global multi-view consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的预测方法与Hunyuan3D-2.0等最新基准的关键区别在于多视图数据的来源和应用。 虽然传统方法预测由多视图传播模型生成的独立图像,但我们在使用专门的非重叠策略之前,从结构一致的视频中预测选定的帧。 我们注意到,虽然多视图传播模型改进了交叉视图对齐,但它们往往牺牲高频细节来保持这种一致性. 为了保存这些细节,我们非重叠战略的起点是从前后视线上投射纹理——即观测重叠最小的两个视角——直接投射到网格上。 随后,从侧面观点得出的纹理被完全投射到以前没有纹理的区域,有效地进行了以预测为基础的涂料工作。 最后,我们的数据驱动的纹理正常化模型纠正了这些预测纹理的缝隙上的任何小文物或不连续性。 这种方法允许OmniFabric保留复杂,高频的表面细节,同时确保全球多视图的一致性.

blocks.en: C.1. Robustness to Structural Variations in Sewing Patterns
blocks.zh: C.1. 对缝纫模式结构变化的强性

blocks.en: Figure S3. Qualitative results. OmniFabric effectively removes distortion artifacts and geometry-induced wrinkles, generating normalized textured sewing patterns that are simulation-ready. A figure showing qualitative results of our method.
blocks.zh: 图S3. 定性结果。 OmniFabric有效移除了扭曲的文物和几何引起的皱纹,生成了正常的纹理缝纫模式,这些模式已经模拟准备. 一个显示我们方法质量结果的数字。

blocks.en: We present further qualitative evaluations in Figure S3 , which demonstrate the robustness of our framework across a variety of garment styles. The results illustrate that our texture normalization model effectively rectifies the coarse texture map by eliminating projection-induced distortions and removing physics-based wrinkles inherent in the initial capture. While the geometry simulated from the predicted sewing patterns may occasionally deviate from the exact silhouette in the input image, we emphasize that such discrepancies arise from the limitations of the underlying sewing pattern prediction method rather than the texturing process. To mitigate this, our pipeline employs a texture transferring model that aligns the input image textures with the rendered silhouette of the predicted garment. This strategy successfully bridges the gap between the predicted geometry and the original observation, ensuring that the synthesized textures remain globally coherent and structurally aligned.
blocks.zh: 我们在图S3中提出了进一步的定性评价,这表明我们的框架在各种服装风格上是强有力的。 结果显示,我们的纹理正常化模型通过消除投影诱导的扭曲,消除初始捕捉中固有的物理皱纹,有效地纠正了粗细的纹理图. 虽然从预测缝纫模式模拟的几何可能偶尔偏离输入图像中准确的硅胶,但我们强调,这种差异来自基本的缝纫模式预测方法的局限性,而不是纹理过程。 为了缓解这种情况,我们的管道采用了一种纹理传输模型,使输入的图像纹理与预测的衣物的成形的淤泥保持一致。 这项战略成功地弥合了预测的几何学和原始观测之间的差距,确保合成的纹理保持全球一致性和结构一致。

blocks.en: C.2. Compatibility with Other Sewing Pattern Prediction Method
blocks.zh: C.2. 与其他排污模式预测方法的兼容性

blocks.en: While the main paper utilizes ChatGarment for sewing pattern prediction, our framework is designed to be agnostic to the specific reconstruction method employed. To demonstrate this flexibility, we evaluated our pipeline using sewing patterns predicted by Alpparel ( Nakayama et al., 2025 ) , a recent state-of-the-art approach based on Large Vision-Language Models. As illustrated in Figure S2 , OmniFabric consistently generates textured garments with aligned geometry and high-frequency details, confirming that our synthesis capability is not restricted to a single pattern reconstruction architecture.It should be noted, however, that the simulated garment geometry may occasionally exhibit minor mismatches relative to the original input image due to imperfect pattern prediction. As discussed in Section C.1 , our methodology specifically focuses on maintaining global texture consistency even when the underlying 3D mesh, which is simulated from predicted sewing pattern, is not perfectly aligned with the reference observation. This robustness ensures that OmniFabric can be seamlessly integrated with future advancements in sewing pattern prediction.
blocks.zh: 主要文件使用 用于缝纫模式预测的ChatGarment, 我们的框架被设计成对所使用的具体重建方法不可知。 为了显示这种灵活性,我们利用Alpparel(中山等人,2025年)预测的缝纫模式评估了我们的管道,这是最近基于大视野-语言模型的先进方法。 如图S2所示,OmniFabric不断生成配有对齐几何和高频细节的纹理服装,证实我们的合成能力并不限于单一模式重建架构. 然而,应当指出的是,由于图案预测不完善,模拟服装几何有时可能与原始输入图像相比出现小不匹配. 如C.1节所述,我们的方法特别侧重于保持全球纹理的一致性,即使从预测缝纫模式模拟出来的3D网与参考观察不完全一致。 这种稳健性确保OmniFabric能够与缝纫模式预测的未来进步无缝结合.

blocks.en: Supplementary Material D D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: D. 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: While OmniFabric represents a significant advancement in garment texturing, several limitations remain that offer promising avenues for future research. First, although our model effectively removes transient lighting artifacts to produce a clean appearance, it does not yet explicitly disentangle albedo from shading in a strictly principled, physics-based manner, a distinction that should be noted to avoid overstating our current appearance decomposition capabilities. Furthermore, because the framework relies on generative priors, unseen or occluded regions are occasionally hallucinated; however, the system is not strictly limited to single-view observations and could incorporate multiple frames or video sequences in practice to reduce these hallucinations and improve reconstruction fidelity. Finally, certain materials with strong view-dependent effects, such as highly reflective leather or metallic fabrics, remain challenging to reconstruct faithfully, suggesting that future iterations should incorporate the joint prediction of complete PBR material maps—including roughness and normal maps—to achieve true photorealism across diverse environmental lighting conditions.
blocks.zh: 虽然OmniFabric是服装纹理方面的一个重大进步,但仍然存在若干限制因素,为今后的研究提供了有希望的途径。 第一,虽然我们的模型有效地清除了瞬态照明文物,以产生干净的外观,但是它还没有以严格的原则性,物理性的方式明确地将反照率从阴影中分解出来,这种区别应该注意,以避免夸大我们目前的外观分解能力. 此外,由于这个框架依赖于基因前科,不见或被占有的地区偶尔会出现幻觉;然而,这个系统并不严格局限于单视观测,并且可以在实践中包含多个帧或视频序列,以减少这些幻觉,提高重建忠心度. 最后,某些具有强烈视差效应的材料,例如高度反射的皮革或金属织物,在忠实重建方面仍然具有挑战性,这表明未来的迭代应包含对完整的PBR材料地图——包括粗糙度和普通地图——的联合预测,以便在不同的环境照明条件下实现真正的光现实化。
